allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix critical multiplayer bugs and add state management system

Major fixes:
- Fix locked object crash: Change free\(\) to queue_free\(\) in card_hand_display
- Fix double cards bug: Remove old turn system calls from end_boss_turn\(\)
- Fix round number jumping: Remove duplicate round_number increment
- Fix extra cards in boss fights: Clear queued_cards during transitions
- Fix disappearing cards: Return all cards to deck before shuffling

State management improvements:
- Add reset_players_between_encounters\(\) for minions→boss transitions
- Add reset_players_for_new_run\(\) for new game starts
- Properly manage deck state to preserve earned cards between encounters
- Clear all temporary combat state \(hands, discard, queued_cards, shield, debuffs\)
- Document state management patterns in .claude/CLAUDE.md

This ensures clean transitions between fights while preserving player progression.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

hooks.command: bash -c 'file_path=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path // empty"); if [[ "$file_path" == *.gd ]]; then echo "[Hook] GDScript file modified: $file_path"; if [ -d "tests" ]; then echo "[Hook] Running tests..."; godot --headless --script tests/run_tests.gd 2>&1 || echo "[Hook] Tests not yet configured - skipping"; else echo "[Hook] No test directory found - skipping tests"; fi; fi'

bash -c 'file_path=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path // empty"); critical_files=("game_manager.gd" "combat.gd" "character.gd" "card.gd" "project.godot"); for critical in "${critical_files[@]}"; do if [[ "$file_path" == *"$critical" ]]; then echo "[Hook] ⚠️  BLOCKING: Attempting to edit critical file: $critical"; echo "[Hook] This file has caused bugs before. Please confirm this change is necessary."; exit 2; fi; done'
